response.answer: Current trends in Engineering & Computer Science include preference-conditioned multi-agent reinforcement learning, scalable collaborative perception frameworks, and attention-based fusion techniques for improved model performance. Reproducible software and rigorous evaluation metrics are emphasized for validation. Practical protocols focus on real-world applicability and scalability.
